name: com.vuztransport.blog/road-freight
title: Vuz Transport road freight
description: Full-truck road freight in Europe: price estimate between two places and sending a quote request.

tools.name: estimate_route_price
tools.description: Indicative price of a full truckload (FTL) between two places in Europe, from Vuz Transport (Polish road carrier). Distance is a rough estimate (straight line x 1.2) unless km is given. Returns total in EUR, a range, the rate per km and a link that opens the calculator and quote form already filled in. Not a binding offer.

from.description: Loading place: city, town or postcode in Europe, in any language (e.g. "Milano", "Munich", "42-200", "08173 ES").

to.description: Unloading place: city, town or postcode in Europe, in any language (e.g. "Milano", "Munich", "42-200", "08173 ES").

km.description: Real road distance in km, if the user knows it.

terms.description: Payment terms: prepaid, or invoice at 30/60/90 days. Default prepaid.

extras.description: adr = dangerous goods, express = faster delivery, weekend = loading or delivery at the weekend.

diesel.description: Diesel price in EUR per litre, if different from today's default.

lang.description: Language of the quote form link. Use the user's language.

tools.name: send_quote_request
tools.description: Sends a transport quote request to the Vuz Transport team by email, exactly like the form on the website. They reply to the customer within 2 working hours on working days. BEFORE calling: show the user every detail you will send (route, date, load, name, email, phone, message), tell them their contact details go to Vuz Transport (privacy notice: https://blog.vuztransport.com/privacy/), and get an explicit yes. Set user_confirmed to true only after that yes. Never invent contact details.

from.description: Loading place: city, town or postcode in Europe, in any language (e.g. "Milano", "Munich", "42-200", "08173 ES").

to.description: Unloading place: city, town or postcode in Europe, in any language (e.g. "Milano", "Munich", "42-200", "08173 ES").

email.description: Customer's email address, where the team will reply.

phone.description: Customer's phone number, with country code. Optional.

load.description: Weight or number of pallets, e.g. "24 t" or "33 pallets". Optional.

cargo.description: ftl = full truck, ltl = part load, dedicated = dedicated truck, other.

message.description: Anything else: goods, ADR class, loading hours, the price estimate the user saw. Optional.

user_confirmed.description: true only after the user has seen these details and said to send them.
